english.note: Use this when the scorn is expressed through mocking, sarcastic remarks rather than silent disdain.
Use this when the cynical manner is expressed through mocking or sarcastic remarks.

examples.english: They spoke scornfully: “So capable—why can’t you even do the job?”
examples.traditional: 佢冷嘲熱諷咁話：「咁叻，點解份工都做唔掂呀？」

examples.english: They cynically remarked that donating to charity was only for getting into the newspaper.
examples.traditional: 佢冷嘲熱諷咁話，捐錢做善事只係為咗上報紙。
